title: A failed save of an unacknowledged evaluator's retirement drops the consumed wait's resume and its deltas
outcome: When retire_unacknowledged_acceptance_evaluator (src/acceptance_evaluation_api.rs) cannot save the retirement (commit_locked returns Err), the parent still gets its wait-resume dispatch and clients still get the lifecycle and wait-consumed deltas. Alternatively, the wait refresh is applied only after a successful commit. The comment no longer claims that "nothing here is blocked".
acceptance: A test whose persist writer fails the retirement's commit shows that a wait registered on the evaluator during its first-brief acknowledgement is either resumed (its parent's resume dispatched) or left registered for a later refresh, never consumed silently without a resume.
The comment at the commit-failure branch states accurately what is and is not settled when the save fails.
disposal_reason: Fixed by w-c2422f97c77d, landed as 7f6281da. src/acceptance_evaluation_api.rs:2360-2383 now runs enqueue_delegation_refresh_locked and publish_delegation_refresh_side_effects whether the retirement's commit succeeds or fails, so a failed save no longer drops the consumed waits' resume dispatch or their deltas. The round-5 RED/GREEN regression proves it (see this item's evidence note). The test-strength follow-up is w-2e89b0895ad7.
